# x402 Token Counter

> Fast approximate token counting for LLM budget & routing decisions. x402 micropayments (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/count – service info
- POST /api/count – paid token count

## Pricing

~0.003 – 0.01 USDC per call (default max 0.006 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": "your prompt or document here...",
  "options": {
    "model": "cl100k"
  }
}
```

Supported model hints: cl100k | o200k | approx | words | chars

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "tokens": 142,
  "chars": 687,
  "words": 98,
  "model": "cl100k",
  "method": "cl100k-approx"
}
```

Agents use this before choosing a model or deciding whether a long context fits the remaining budget.
